Everyday Cool

Version 1.1.1

The whole workshop in one app: every room of the Everyday Cool collection — the radios, the benches, the sky, the map, the games — exactly as it appears on the web, in a single installable program.

Built by Steven Powell with the Council. Most of the workshop runs fully offline; a few rooms use live data when you are online, and links that leave the workshop open in your default browser.

The live collection: caeled.github.io/everyday-cool
